name: nimbus-harness
description: The Nimbus agentic harness: the policy/orchestration layer of the on-device Orchestrator, lifted out of src/agent into a standalone, host-testable library. Composes the nimbus-core mechanisms (turn contract, head loop, tool registry, memory engines) behind explicit injected contracts — Platform, HarnessConfig, HttpTransport, Channel, DeviceExec, Hooks — so the full turn pipeline runs on the host with fakes (test/test_harness_*) and on the device behind thin glue. Depends on nimbus-core; no Arduino dependencies.
